revisions.name: Padded
revisions.summary: Padded (Light Armor): Armor Class 11 + Dex modifier; Strength —; Stealth Disadvantage; 8 lb.; 5 gp.

effects.text: If you wear light armor, you add your Dexterity modifier to the base number from your armor type to determine your Armor Class. If the Armor table shows “Disadvantage” in the Stealth column, the wearer has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Only those proficient in the armor’s use know how to wear it effectively. If you wear armor that you lack proficiency with, you have disadvantage on any ability check, saving throw, or attack roll that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can’t cast spells.

revisions.name: Chain mail
revisions.summary: Chain mail (Heavy Armor): Armor Class 16; Strength Str 13; Stealth Disadvantage; 55 lb.; 75 gp.

effects.text: Heavy armor doesn’t let you add your Dexterity modifier to your Armor Class, but it also doesn’t penalize you if your Dexterity modifier is negative. If the Armor table shows “Str 13” or “Str 15” in the Strength column for an armor type, the armor reduces the wearer’s speed by 10 feet unless the wearer has a Strength score equal to or higher than the listed score. If the Armor table shows “Disadvantage” in the Stealth column, the wearer has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Only those proficient in the armor’s use know how to wear it effectively. If you wear armor that you lack proficiency with, you have disadvantage on any ability check, saving throw, or attack roll that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can’t cast spells.

revisions.name: Shield
revisions.summary: Shield: Armor Class +2; Strength —; Stealth —; 6 lb.; 10 gp.

effects.text: A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
